'''Raquor''' was a deity worshipped by [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]]. [[Raquor'daan/Legends|Raquor'daan]] took their name after it, as this [[God/Legends|God]] was suppose to take the form of a Dark Wolf when he traversed the wastes of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> Raquor was the brother of [[Quay (deity)|Quay]] and helped to watch over the prison of [[Quay'va]].<ref name="LoNH" />
